name: Khymerae

bonuses.name: Otherworldly
bonuses.text: The Khymerae shifts between the physical world and the Warp with ease, blows passing straight through its incorporeal form. Khymerae have +2 AR*

determination: Phased Defence: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 5d6. This Threat can roll determination against Mortal Wounds.
note: The SKILLS line prints no "Default" label ("SKILLS: 3, Athletics 7..."); 3 is stored as the Default pool. The "+2 AR*" asterisk has no footnote. Apocrypha's apoc-khymera is a different printing.
